lines.en: A gurney rattling as it rolled along. Aileen and the citizens on the council bustled about, carrying me somewhere. As though I were a critically ill patient, an IV had been inserted into me, and I could feel finely broken Story fragments flowing through it without pause.
Despite the urgency of the situation, my mind was gradually growing calmer.
I decided to take a moment to sort out the situation.
[You currently hold the right of succession to the ‘Gilobat Industrial Complex’.]
How had I become a Revolutionary and finally gained the right of succession to the ‘Gilobat Industrial Complex’?
The answer to that question was simple.
「‘Kim Dokja’ killed the Ruler of the ‘Gilobat Industrial Complex’.」
At first glance, it might look like circular reasoning, but it wasn't.
Because the ‘Kim Dokja’ in that industrial complex wasn't me.
In other words, someone had impersonated me, built up a reputation there, and finally killed its Ruler.
[The <Star Stream> is correcting a scenario error.]
[A new Story involving you is scheduled.]
What kind of lunatic could possibly do something like that?
Obviously, there couldn't be two lunatics like that.
「Kim Dokja thought. Yoo Joonghyuk is in the ‘Gilobat Industrial Complex’ right now.」
At first, I was swept up in pure gratitude.
Ah! Our Yoo Joonghyuk had finally become a decent human being!
The bastard had stormed that industrial complex to save me!
For a while, I basked in that feeling without really thinking about it.
But when I thought it over, there was no way that could be true.
That ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ had stormed the ‘Gilobat Industrial Complex’ to save me?
To begin with, the very idea that Yoo Joonghyuk knew I was in danger was strange.
He wasn't a constellation and couldn't even access the channel. How could he have known I was in danger?
So it was much more likely that Yoo Joonghyuk had come for the opposite reason.
He'd realized I was impersonating him and come to the Demon Realm to beat the shit out of me.
Then something must have gone wrong along the way, leading him to visit the ‘Gilobat Industrial Complex’ first, get dragged into an unnecessary fight, and turn the whole place upside down.
I couldn't even begin to imagine how much rage it would take to do something like that.
“I'm treating you. Stop trembling.”
Aileen, who was working on my Stories in the treatment room, frowned and pushed up her glasses. I answered sheepishly.
“Sorry. It's instinctive. How am I doing?”
“It's your own body. Stop talking as though it belongs to someone else.”
Despite all her deep sighs, Aileen's expression didn't look that grim.
“I can only call it a miracle. You're gradually starting to recover. Your Stories are too badly damaged for you to move around carelessly······ Still, I think you'll be all right if you rest.”
Perhaps because I'd reentered the ‘main scenario’, even breathing felt different.
People who hadn't experienced it couldn't know what it felt like to become an exile and then return to the scenario.
「Kim Dokja thought. So this is a ‘story’.」
The feeling of a vast, warm world wrapping itself around me.
Ridiculously enough, it almost felt as though I was only now truly alive. Just thinking about who could have designed this ‘sensation’ frightened me.
“Don't move around!”
Aileen's sharp voice was accompanied by a surge of intense pain.
[Your current Story composition is incomplete.]
Even if entering the scenario had put me on the road to recovery, my injuries were still severe.
Well, after what I'd suffered while killing Duke Syswitz, being alive at all was a miracle. Even I thought that battle had been reckless.
I didn't quite know why I'd gone that far. It wasn't like me.
[Several constellations are asking around for stories about you.]
Besides, I'd summoned an actual ‘Story Weapon’, which meant the story ahead had become immensely complicated.
I opened the message log I'd been putting off checking.
[Most constellations in the channel were greatly impressed by your performance!]
[You have received a donation of 3000 coins.]
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ nods at your confidence.]
[You have received a donation of 4000 coins.]
Donations. It had been a while.
Somehow, I felt deeply moved.
[The twentieth main scenario has ended.]
[You have cleared the main scenario ― ‘Demon Realm Revolution’.]
[Receipt of rewards is delayed due to excessive skipping of main scenarios.]
[Receipt of the Story for clearing the main scenario is pending.]
There were a few problems, but the scenario messages had come through properly, too.
[Some constellations are curious about your identity!]
[Several constellations wish to invite you to their nebulas!]
[Someone is coveting your Story Weapon!]
The familiar nonsense had started up, too.
I could understand why they were getting so worked up.
「Story Weapon Pluto」
A Story Weapon on the level of a Giant Soldier was something even constellations coveted.
After all, Giant Soldiers were rare weapons that could only be seen when <Gigantomachia>, one of the Giant Stories, was activated.
A weapon that could trample the Legendary-grade Story [Factory] like a toy, even without its summoner aboard.
There was no way the constellations wouldn't covet a weapon like that.
Anyway, it seemed ‘that gentleman’ hadn't arrived yet······.
[The constellation ‘Father of the Rich Night’ is watching you.]
······He was here. Damn it.
[The constellation ‘Father of the Rich Night’ is watching you.]
Father of the Rich Night.

Fortunately, he did nothing in particular besides watch me. He had every reason to be angry, since I'd used his Story Weapon without permission······ No, perhaps being watched by Hades was frightening enough in itself. He was the king of the Underworld, after all.
[The exclusive skill ‘Fourth Wall’ activates strongly!]
[‘Fourth Wall’ snickers.]
Damn it, that irritating thing couldn't have been more reassuring.
Of course, I was now a ‘Narrative-grade constellation’ in my own right, so in terms of Status, I might at least be able to measure up to one of Hades's toes. The problem was my current condition.
The bandages wound tightly around my whole body spoke for the state of my injuries.
An incarnation body was the phenotype (表現型) of Status.
With the phenotype damaged, the constellation's Status naturally had to diminish as well.
Seriously, I'd never been hurt this badly in my life······.
I could barely move an arm, but if anything brought me comfort, it was the smartphone in my hand.
When I grinned, Aileen frowned again as she wound my bandages.
“······I told you not to stare at that for too long.”
“My mother always said that, too.”
“You absolutely must get complete rest.”
“For me, looking at this is complete rest.”
I deliberately didn't explain the details.
Even if I did, she clearly wouldn't understand, or it would all get filtered anyway.
“How's the Syswitz Industrial Complex doing? No, I suppose I should call it the ‘Yoo Joonghyuk Industrial Complex’ now.”
“It's doing all right.”
After the duke's death, the industrial complex was gradually regaining stability.
There was plenty of debate over the treatment of the [Removal Slaves] and the remaining nobles who'd been taken prisoner, but Aileen was handling it well.
After watching me for a moment, Aileen asked,
“You're not actually ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’, are you?”
It was a question I'd expected, so I nodded.
“That's right. I'm not.”
“But ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ is the owner of this ‘industrial complex’ now.”
She was certainly right about that.
My messages had mentioned it, too.
[The current owner of the industrial complex is ‘Duke Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
‘Duke Yoo Joonghyuk’······.
That bastard really ought to be grateful to me.
I looked at Aileen and said,
“His illustrious Grace will be visiting in person soon.”
At those words, a peculiar tension crept into Aileen's expression.
“······What kind of demon is Yoo Joonghyuk?”
“He's not a demon. Though he does act like one sometimes.”
After wondering how to explain it, I decided to tell her this.
“The Yoo Joonghyuk of this round is a good guy.”
Aileen didn't seem to understand what that meant.
I shook my head and said,
“Anyway, I have a favor to ask. Could you call Jang Hayoung and Han Myungoh for me? I have something to discuss with them.”
“······All right.”
For now, I'd made it past one hurdle.
But that was literally all it was: ‘one hurdle’.
The ‘Revolutionary Scenario’ was over, but the scenario to follow would be so much larger in scale that it couldn't even be compared to the ‘Revolutionary Scenario’.
[Several Demon Kings take an interest in your activities.]
If I let my guard down even a little, I'd be the one getting devoured.
So I had to start preparing, step by step, right now.
Once Aileen's presence had completely faded, I opened the file on the panel screen without hesitation.
―Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World(First Revised Version).txt
Was it because I was reading ‘Ways of Survival’ for the first time in a while?
My heart was already pounding.
What did ‘First Revised Version’ mean?
And why on earth had the author given this to me······?
But the file didn't appear on the screen right away. Perhaps it was because Aileen's smartphone was an imitation. Its performance was enough to make me miss my old phone.
Only after a considerable wait did the file finally open.
“······Is the problem that the file's too big, rather than the phone being slow?”
Well, a file this size would take time to load even on a PC that wasn't optimized. Faced with an enormous quantity of text for the first time in a while, I felt a little overwhelmed.
Damn, how had I read all of this?
To find out where and how the story had been revised, I had no choice but to reread it from the beginning, line by line, and compare it with my memory.
I'd read perhaps the first ten pages that way.
······Doesn't seem like much has changed?
It still started on the subway, and Yoo Joonghyuk was still doing the same things······.
Besides, why was this bastard's dialogue still like this, even in the revised version?
Then, for the first time, a sentence appeared that hadn't been in the original ‘Ways of Survival’.
「Yoo Joonghyuk thought. ‘If it were him, he wouldn't have thought this way.’」
A chill made me stop.
「‘If that guy had been here, the judgment would have been a little different, but...’」
Without thinking, I scrolled back to an earlier page. The text stuttered because of the smartphone's performance, but I had no time to worry about that.
An ominous premonition flashed through my mind.
I was missing something.
······The opening scene was the same?
No. This was an entirely different beginning.
I scrolled to the very first page of episode 1 of ‘Ways of Survival’ and stared at it blankly for a long time.
“······It wasn't the 3rd round.”
The First Revised Version of ‘Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World’.
I read the novel's first sentence again.
「And so, Yoo Joonghyuk's fourth life began.」
The First Revised Version began with Yoo Joonghyuk's 4th round.
「Yoo Joonghyuk thought.」
「‘He doesn't exist in this round.’」
He doesn't exist in this round······.
The moment I read that sentence, an electric current ran through me from head to toe.
······Surely not.
Of course it couldn't be.
There were plenty of people Yoo Joonghyuk might call ‘that guy’.
Just how many ‘guys’ had Yoo Joonghyuk met in his previous rounds? There was no way it could be me······.
But as I read Yoo Joonghyuk's thoughts, which appeared from time to time, my mind grew tangled.
「Yoo Joonghyuk thought.」
「‘He told me not to think things would improve just by repeating rounds.’」
「‘That this life was only this life.’」
「‘I don't know whether I can do it. Still, I won't give up.’」
Damn it, no matter how I looked at it, those were things I'd said.
I scrolled down quickly, skimming other scenes.
Words supposedly left by ‘that guy’ kept appearing afterward. The name ‘Kim Dokja’ was never written even once, but they sounded like things I'd said to him at some point.

Of course, I didn't remember everything I'd said either, so I couldn't be one hundred percent certain. But however I thought about it, there was no one besides me who would say those things to Yoo Joonghyuk. Anyone else who'd spoken so insolently would have lost their head to Yoo Joonghyuk long ago.
“······This is seriously going to drive me insane.”
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ is curious about your muttering.]
I ignored the message from the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, and slowly took a deep breath.
I clearly needed to sort out my thoughts.
There was still time.
Unexpectedly, the [Fourth Wall] helped me.
「Kim Dokja thought. In essence, this was the current situation.」
All right, let's hear it.
「One, the First Revised Version of ‘Ways of Survival’ had arrived.」
「Two, the revised version began with Yoo Joonghyuk's 4th round.」
「Three, a person presumed to be ‘Kim Dokja’ appeared in the 4th-round Yoo Joonghyuk's recollections.」
It was an admirably clear account.
And there was only one fact those three points suggested,
「Yoo Joonghyuk's ‘3rd round’ had failed.」
However much I thought about it, I could see no other conclusion.
If Yoo Joonghyuk and I had reached the ending of this world, there was no way he would have moved on to the 4th round.
In other words, this was the most reasonable deduction.
The 3rd round in which I'd intervened had failed, and the rounds after that failure had been newly recorded in this revised version of ‘Ways of Survival’.
I wondered how such a thing could happen, but this was a world where far too many impossible things had already happened.
I let out a short sigh and examined the text file of ‘Ways of Survival’ again.
One question had been resolved, but a whole pile of others remained.
With the [Fourth Wall], I first sorted through the questions that came to mind, one by one.
「Why don't ‘I’ exist in Yoo Joonghyuk's ‘4th round’?」
However much I thought about that, I couldn't find an answer.

It might be because I wasn't a character, or it might be because of some other problem. In any case, one thing was certain: from the 4th round onward, ‘I’ no longer existed. So the question I needed to focus on more closely was the second one.
「If the ‘First Revised Version’ describes future events, could a ‘Second Revised Version’ appear depending on what I do from now on?」
Nothing was certain.
I couldn't rule out the possibility that this ‘First Revised Version’ was a ‘fixed future’.
But I was convinced that it most likely wasn't.
If this were a ‘fixed future’, there was no way the author would have gone out of their way to send it to me.
I didn't quite know why, but the author had given me a chance through this ‘revised version’.
If things continued like this, the 3rd round would end in failure, and the 4th-round Yoo Joonghyuk would once again repeat his regressions alone.
It amounted to a warning.
Of course, the author might have an appallingly twisted sense of amusement······ But thinking about that possibility wouldn't get me anywhere anyway, so I decided not to consider it.
“For now, that means I have to read all of this······ My head's going to split.”
Pressing my throbbing temples, I continued reading ‘Ways of Survival’.
Some parts had changed, and others remained the same.
In any case, countless feelings mingled within me as I reread the story.
‘Yoo Joonghyuk, you bastard. After all the shit I did, you're doing this again.’
Thoughts like that, and
‘Huh? Look at this. You've changed a little after all.’
Thoughts like those.
‘That's right. This bit was really fun. I liked this part.’
‘Fuck, there's so much goddamn exposition······.’
‘······No, but the prose seems a little cleaner. Has the author improved?’
As I scrolled through the pages, immersed in those thoughts, I found myself returning to my true self as a reader and falling into ‘Ways of Survival’.
He was still repeating the same sunfish antics, but one interesting thing was that my intervention had reduced some of Yoo Joonghyuk's minor mistakes.
Particularly striking was how, in his 4th round, he'd started by killing an ‘ichthyosaur’ at Oksu Station, just as I had.
「Yoo Joonghyuk thought. ‘That guy must have obtained a hidden scenario here, too.’」
And he hadn't died in the [Theatre Dungeon] in his 8th and 11th rounds.
「‘······I survived here thanks to him. Well, I would have found some way to survive even if he'd left me alone.’」
When I read that part, I was so moved I almost cried.
If I'd had somewhere to brag about it, I would have.
‘Look, everyone. That goddamn sunfish bastard has grown this much.’
Of course, since I was the only reader of ‘Ways of Survival’, there was no way I had anywhere to brag.
After I'd been scrolling quickly for quite some time, a sudden question made me stop.
Wait a minute. Doesn't this guy seem to be doing better than I expected?
Then what happens next?
Had the Yoo Joonghyuk I'd influenced······ reached the proper ‘ending’ of this world?
“What? You look fine. Aileen said you were practically dying.”
“Kim······ Joonghyuk-ssi. Are you feeling any better?”
The door creaked open, and Jang Hayoung and Han Myungoh came in.
Come to think of it, I'd completely forgotten I'd asked Aileen to call these two.
“Oh, isn't that a smartphone?”
At the sight of the device in my hand, Jang Hayoung brightened and rushed over.
I casually switched the phone to my other hand and answered.
“No. Go away.”
“Can it send texts? Make calls? Use the internet?”
“Of course it can't.”
Jang Hayoung looked crestfallen at my cold reply and said,
“······Then why'd you call me?”
“Have you kept trying to contact the constellations I told you about?”
“Oh, them?”
Jang Hayoung shrugged and said,
“They didn't seem very interested.”
“Really?”
The scenarios ahead would be difficult to overcome with my strength alone.

The enemies I'd faced so far had been disasters that descended through scenarios or individual constellations, but those who would obstruct me from now on were bigger than that. For instance, bastards like <Vedas>, who'd screwed me over with that damn ‘fate’.
So to oppose them, I needed to find out what constellations or transcendents who thought like me were doing.
“They all seemed busy with their own things. Most of them barely even reply.”
But······ apparently, it was still too early.
Originally, Jang Hayoung became the ‘King of Transcendents’ much later in the story. So even constellations who'd sided with Jang Hayoung in the original novel might think differently at this point.
Besides, even the ‘original novel’ had already changed.
I sighed and said,
“Fine. You can leave.”
“······What? You're the one who called me here.”
Once Jang Hayoung left, grumbling, only Han Myungoh and I remained in the treatment room. After hesitantly gauging my mood, Han Myungoh spoke first.
“There's something odd about you. I've known that since we worked at the company, but······.”
“Enough of that. You know why I called you here, don't you?”
“Ahem.”
As expected, the perceptive Han Myungoh seemed to know why I'd called him.
“······Actually, I still haven't been able to make contact.”
“Shouldn't the vassal connection have recovered by now?”
“It has. But there's no response from the Demon King.”

Not long ago, I'd used the power of the [Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword] to sever the connection between Han Myungoh and the Demon King ‘Asmodeus’. But that was only temporary. I thought it was about time Asmodeus contacted him again.
And yet there had still been no contact······.
“Do you have any idea why?”
“Perhaps he no longer trusts me. Or······.”
But at that moment, Han Myungoh's expression changed with a crackling sensation.
“Th-the vassal connection's working!”
I immediately tensed.
The Demon King Asmodeus.
One of the most powerful of the 72 Demon Kings was about to address me through Han Myungoh's eyes and mouth.
But Han Myungoh's expression was a little strange.
“Huh?”
“What is it?”
“I think something's wrong.”
“What's happened?”
“H-he's come in person!”
“What?”
“The Demon King has come in person!”
A part of my heart went cold.
The Demon King had come in person. What that meant was simple.
The Demon King ‘Asmodeus’ had brought his incarnation body to visit this scenario area himself.
As I continued receiving channel messages through Biyoo, I asked,
“Has he come somewhere nearby?”
“I-I think he's already found you······.”
He'd already found me?
But however much I heightened my senses, I couldn't sense a Demon King.

If a Demon King really had come nearby, not only would all the constellations in the channel have gone into an uproar, but the immense pressure exerted by his incarnation body should have caused the incarnations in the area to bleed from all seven facial orifices and die. But······.
“Wait. Don't tell me······?”
Come to think of it, I'd been operating here under the name ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.
So other Demon Kings who hadn't entered the channel and didn't know the exact situation around me were likely to infer my location from my reputation in the <Star Stream>.
And according to the <Star Stream>, my current location was······.
“Goddamn it.”
“Wh-what's wrong all of a sudden?”
“Department Head Han, which direction is the [Gilobat Industrial Complex] from here?”
Yoo Joonghyuk was in danger.
“Kim Dokja-nim!”
“Long live Kim Dokja-nim!”
“The industrial complex is independent!”
Listening to the cheers erupting throughout the Gilobat Industrial Complex, Yoo Joonghyuk stood with a conflicted expression.
‘I hadn't intended to go this far.’
Yoo Joonghyuk frowned as he looked at ‘Duke Gilobat’, who had died by his hand.
Bzzt, bzzzt.

Sparks were scorching parts of Yoo Joonghyuk's body black after he'd released too much of the power he'd accumulated as a transcendent. Perhaps it was because this wasn't a power he should have released at this stage.
‘It was too early to unlock Stage 1 of Transcendent Form.’

But without releasing that power, killing a duke of the Demon Realm in such a short time would have been impossible. It was a power he'd deliberately concealed even from the constellations, yet one of them, of all people, had seen it. Yoo Joonghyuk looked at the Uriel doll sitting on his shoulder and thought,
‘Though the one who actually saw it doesn't seem to think anything of it.’
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is pleased with your achievement.]
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is moved by your camaraderie.]
“······Dukes give a lot of coins. That's the only reason I killed him.”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ grins.]
Without responding to that message, Yoo Joonghyuk turned toward the panel screen in the duke's office. It was playing a low-quality scenario video that appeared to have been recorded by Wenny men.
―It's Yoo Joonghyuk!
―I am Yoo Joonghyuk!
It was an absurd scene. Hundreds of people in a crowd were all shouting that they were Yoo Joonghyuk. Most ridiculous of all was the pale bastard at the center, shouting louder than anyone.
―It's Yoo Joonghyuk! It's Yoo Joonghyuk! Wooo!
After watching the scene with a furrowed brow, Yoo Joonghyuk turned his head.
[A faint blush appears on the cheeks of the constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’.]
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ urges you to hurry and leave to meet Kim Dokja.]
But Yoo Joonghyuk shook his head.
“······I've confirmed he's alive. That's enough. Cancel the personal scenario and send me back to my original world.”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is startled!]
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ says the personal scenario isn't over yet.]
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ says the personal scenario requires you to meet Kim Dokja and······.]
“Did you think I'd actually accept a personal scenario like that?”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ suffers a great shock.]

The Uriel doll's shoulders trembled, and she wore an expression she probably wouldn't have shown even if <Eden> had been destroyed. After watching her for a moment, Yoo Joonghyuk let out a small breath and asked,
“More importantly, are you going to be all right?”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ raises her head with a dejected expression.]
“This has made me a duke of the Demon Realm. But you're an archangel. I'm asking whether there's any problem with us traveling together.”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is greatly flustered.]
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ says she hadn't thought that far ahead.]
“······Damn it.”
As Yoo Joonghyuk inwardly unleashed every curse he could think of and wondered what to do with this hopeless archangel,
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ issues a warning!]
With a crackling sound, an immense darkness began to surge in from all around.
At that terrifying energy, Yoo Joonghyuk instinctively drew the [Splitting the Sky Sword]. But this was not an enemy he could defeat merely by drawing a sword.
A pitch-black abyss gathering into a single essence (精髓).
The deepest darkness of this Demon Realm was manifesting before his eyes.
Yoo Joonghyuk knew this darkness well.
“Run. I can't protect your symbolic body.”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ says she cannot do that.]
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’······.]
Yoo Joonghyuk's shoulders were trembling faintly.

The Uriel doll, who had never seen him like this, grasped his shoulder in alarm. But the trembling wouldn't subside. As though unwilling to acknowledge his fear, Yoo Joonghyuk forced the words out through gritted teeth.
“······I've been killed by that bastard once before.”
The next moment, the darkness revealed its true form, accompanied by an immense aura that made every incarnation nearby burst apart.
[So this is where you were, ‘Demon King of Salvation’.]
When I asked to be taken to the Gilobat Industrial Complex immediately, Aileen answered like this.
“Even at the fastest possible speed, it takes more than two days to get to the Gilobat Industrial Complex from here. With help from a transcendent being, it might be different, but······.”
“The delegation must have some means of transport they came in. Would even that be too slow?”
“Two days is assuming we use that.”
Two days······ Even two hours was too long for me.
At the very latest, I'd have to arrive within an hour to salvage even a piece of Yoo Joonghyuk's corpse.
I racked my brain for a way.
“Help from a ‘transcendent being’······.”
The first one who came to mind was ‘Hermes’.
With that constellation's blessing, I could probably cover a distance that normally took two days in less than a few minutes.
The problem was that he belonged to <Olympus>.
“······I'd rather fucking die than ask those bastards for help.”
“What?”
I waved a hand dismissively at the startled Aileen.
“Just talking to myself.”
Of course, I'd deliberately said it aloud.
Because.
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ wonders what on earth is going on.]
[A constellation who enjoys changing genders wonders what has happened.]
[A very small number of constellations are curious about the information you have concealed.]
To provoke exactly this reaction.
Deliberately ignoring their messages, I began speaking to Aileen.
“Isn't there another way? A warp portal or something like that······.”
“This is the 73rd Demon Realm. It's the backwater of backwaters in the Great Demon Realm. There's no way we'd have such an advanced means of transport.”
“······I suppose not.”
“What on earth is going on?”
“Someone's about to die.”
“Who?”
“The person who's going to own this industrial complex.”
Then, just as I'd expected, my message log exploded.
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ asks what on earth you mean.]
[A constellation who enjoys changing genders listens to your story.]
······It was still rather modest for an explosion, but there weren't many constellations in the channel, so that couldn't be helped.
Anyway, I had no idea how that gender-changing whatsit had found out about this place and come here, either.
“Prisoner of the Golden Headband. Could you help me?”
When I addressed a constellation directly, everyone in the treatment room looked startled. I decided to be even more brazen.
“If you don't mind, I'd like to borrow your Nimbus Cloud.”
Nimbus Cloud, one of the Star Relics (星遺物) of the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal.

With that alone, I could travel straight from here to the Gilobat Industrial Complex in the shortest possible time. The problem was whether the difficult Great Sage, Heaven's Equal would risk the probability cost to lend me that Star Relic. He'd already wasted probability once because of me······.
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ asks why you need the ‘Nimbus Cloud’.]
I thought for a moment before speaking. I had to choose my words carefully here.
“I impersonated Yoo Joonghyuk a little. And Yoo Joonghyuk impersonated me······ Anyway, that caused a scenario error, and now there's a bit of a problem······.”
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ grows irritated.]
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ dislikes complicated things.]
I decided to sum up the situation in a way that the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal would have the patience for.
“Yoo Joonghyuk is about to die because of me.”
I'd thought that putting it that way would make him understand and help, but the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal reacted in a way I hadn't expected.
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ tears out a handful of hair due to stress.]
“Wait a moment.”
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ leaves to find a hairbrush.]
“Hello?”
There was no reply from the departed Great Sage, Heaven's Equal.
[A constellation who enjoys changing genders is amused by this situation.]
[You have received a donation of 100 coins.]
As I stared blankly up into the air, Aileen asked,
“I don't quite understand, but you're saying the person who's going to become the new owner of this industrial complex is in danger?”
“······That's right.”
“Why?”
